title: Lock the Maker Stack composition
question: All three use the same visual world. Which structure should govern the real responsive build?

options.label: Stacked Case File
options.thesis: A large active project card carries the product, with maker evidence unfolding beneath it.
options.viewport: Identity at left, one dominant HLP Labs card at right, project tabs above, and the maker layer docked below.
options.risk: The most balanced option, but the split between introduction and work is more conventional.

options.label: Browse / Maker Split
options.thesis: The finished interface and the thinking behind it remain visible at the same time.
options.viewport: A slim identity rail frames one enormous card split between the live HLP Labs experience and its design, system, and shipping evidence.
options.risk: The strongest proof structure, but it is dense and demands careful mobile adaptation.

options.label: Spatial Project Stack
options.thesis: All four products inhabit one navigable workspace, with the selected card opening its evidence drawer.
options.viewport: The active HLP Labs card dominates a staggered horizontal stack while Keep Up, Sellphy, and Finance Me remain visibly within reach.
options.risk: The most memorable option, but the spatial behavior must collapse intelligently rather than merely shrink on mobile.
